'''Mawan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==
A civil war known as the [[Great Purge]] in [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] left the beautiful capital [[Naatan]] devastated and in the control of three rival crimelords, one of them being [[Granta Omega]] in disguise. In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] restored the planet to peace, though not before [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] died from a deadly chemical weapon she absorbed to save the city of Naatan and thousands of inhabitants. The weapon was detonated by Omega.

Later, [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] murdered [[Zokor Polpot]] on Mawan.

==Society==
The social structure on Mawan was rather hierarchal, with the utilities (especially the water system) being run by the lowest caste. After the civil war, however, the structure was completely disrupted, with some utility workers gaining moderate power and exploitation of the common citizens.
